steps.title: Heat transfer — educational example
steps.general_explanation: Heat is removed from the power cycle by cooling equipment; the design determines how.
unknowns: The drawing does not establish the selected plant’s equipment or cooling-water route.

steps.title: Reuse or discharge — educational example
steps.general_explanation: Depending on the design, water may be cooled and reused, released, or partly lost by evaporation.
unknowns: This is not evidence that the selected plant uses a once-through river system or forms a particular thermal plume.

limitations: The drawing does not track an actual droplet or depict the real pipe layout.

Historical cooling codes are not a current engineering inspection; mixed/unknown codes remain educational.
journey.ai_role: Ridge estimates the temperature difference across a cooling system for a completed month. Environmental reports use reviewed sources and rules, not a trained environmental-safety model.
